title: Ground Broken for First Phase of The Foundry District in Oshawa
summary: Nearly four decades after the Fittings Factory closed, Medallion Corporation officially broke ground today on The Foundry District, a new community planned for a long-vacant industrial site in Downtown Oshawa. The first phase will bring 10- and 23-storey purpose-built rental buildings to the 23-acre property at 135 Bruce Street, as the opening stage of a much larger mixed-use redevelopment.
